entries.name: Transplanted Gullet

counterPressure.note: Built for the death-spawn, not the damage. Its own raw-stat line is a single low-band atom.might, deliberately thin against a fused-rung pool roll of two to three affixes — the muzzle exists to seed the field after the kill, not to win the fight before it.

entries.flavor: A zombie's own throat, grafted muzzle-first onto living cane. What it swallows on the way down takes root on the way out.
entries.notes: Role armament-primary, axis utility, rung band 50 (fused/chimeric). Base item.plant-muzzle-a-005 'Lobbed Gourd' (seedpod class, band a). Capability atom.gardener (spawn.entity, OnDeath) is the item's whole reason to exist; the fixed core stays at two atoms (implicit + might) inside the four-atom cap, one variance slot. atom.gardener is shipped (naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies g.on-death existingFamilies) and already ships in surv-util-008/020 as a utility-axis capability, so the axis assignment matches precedent. No element param — verdant-graft's own elementAffinity is empty and its avoid-list names 'any single dominant element', so this file carries no params.element anywhere.

entries.name: Hybridised Cistern

counterPressure.note: The stem spends its own growth on storage rather than aggression: a slight authored drawback against atom.might, the band-side an author may write per core.v1.json's counterPressure.kinds.drawback shape (severityBand plus a family reference, no magnitude typed).

entries.flavor: Half stem, half stomach, sutured to hold whatever the wearer feeds it — sunlight, coin, or worse — until it is ready to give some back.
entries.notes: Role core-guard, axis economy, rung band 50. Base item.plant-stem-a-005 'Feathered Phloem' (husk class, band a). atom.midas is shipped (naming.v1.json g.economy existingFamilies) and is the same family charm.econ-002/004/etc. use for the economy axis, so this unique's axis claim matches an already-established mapping rather than inventing one.

entries.name: Uncanny Carapace

counterPressure.note: A ward-array slot fixed for offense rather than mitigation, the same class of generator-rule break the unique.exemplar documents on a head-guard slot: role x family pool legality is enforced by filtering the drawn pool on affix_pool_tag, and a unique's fixed atoms sit outside that pool entirely, so this costs no schema or code change. It stays a worse pure shield than a chimeric-rung rare on that axis — its own atom.warded line is only low-band.

entries.flavor: Bark grown thick over a graft that never fully took. Strike it and the wound remembers you before the plant does.
entries.notes: Role ward-array, axis offense, rung band 50. Base item.plant-sheath-a-011 'Petrified Rind' (heartwood class, band a). atom.retribution is shipped (naming.v1.json g.on-hit existingFamilies, alongside searing_strike/lifesteal/volley).

entries.name: Stitched Proboscis

counterPressure.note: Condition from core.v1.json's closed counterPressure.conditions list (leaf hpBelowMilli, already a shipped predicate leaf). The graft feeds harder only once its host is starving — full strength only below half health, ordinary at full health.

entries.flavor: A censer sewn from a feeding tube that never learned to stop. It drinks harder the hungrier its host becomes.
entries.notes: Role armament-secondary, axis survivability, rung band 50. Base item.plant-thorn-a-003 'Smoking Nettle' (censer class, band a), whose own implicit is already atom.lifesteal at low — the unique's fixed core raises the same family to high rather than introducing a second sustain mechanic.

entries.name: Anther of Twinflesh

counterPressure.note: Condition from core.v1.json's closed list (leaf rowIs). The spore cloud only reaches whoever is standing at the front of the lawn, never the back ranks.

entries.flavor: Pollen bred from two bloodlines that should never have shared a stem. It does not know which garden it belongs to, so it claims both.
entries.notes: Role jewel-major, axis control, rung band 50. Base item.plant-pollen-a-009 'Cohered Stigma' (class 'graft', band a) — the base type's own class literally names this theme. Concept 'Twinflesh' drawn from words.v1.json uniqueSetSeedPools['verdant-graft'] (unused by the verdant-graft set file, which spends halfgreen/sapvein/engraftment/conjunction only). atom.sporing is shipped (defined directly in affix-families/g-affliction.json) and off-ctrl-009 already tags the same family axis 'control', matching this claim. Tag 'offensive' for the control axis follows off-ctrl-001..010's own precedent, all of which tag axis:control as offensive.

entries.name: Welted Cilium

counterPressure.note: A moderate authored drawback against its own atom.might: the hand spends its strength directing the graft's allies rather than striking with it.

entries.flavor: A single hair-fine nerve, transplanted whole, that still answers to a voice its new body has never heard.
entries.notes: Role manipulator, axis utility, rung band 50. Base item.plant-leaves-a-002 'Wispy Stipule' (fibre class, band a). atom.commanding is shipped (classes.v1.json implicitSlates excludedForRole family reference) and surv-util-010 already carries it as a utility-axis capability.

entries.name: Crossbred Canopy

counterPressure.note: A pure economy niche piece: it channels captured sunlight into stored currency instead of raw growth, so its own vitality line stays low-band against a chimeric-rung pool roll of three to four affixes.

entries.flavor: Ancient heartwood split and re-closed around scavenged tissue. It still turns toward the sun; it has simply stopped asking why.
entries.notes: Role mantle, axis economy, rung band 50. Base item.plant-canopy-b-004 'Ancient Bough' (heartwood class, band b), whose own implicit is already atom.cleansing — kept as the varianceSlot family rather than displaced. Noun 'Canopy' is mantle's own plant display word (core.v1.json roles.list), used per words.v1.json poolAccess.uniquePartition's 'any nounPools entry ... should sound like it'.

entries.name: Implanted Coronet

counterPressure.note: Condition from core.v1.json's closed list (leaf actorIsKiller). The pod only detonates when the wearer lands the kill, never on an ally's or a passive death.

entries.flavor: A seed pod grafted where a skull should end. It waits for the wearer's kill, then blooms outward through whatever is still standing.
entries.notes: Role head-guard, axis offense, rung band 50 — the same role-breaking pattern the unique exemplar documents (a guard slot fixed for offense, legal because fixed atoms bypass the drawn pool's role x family legality). Base item.plant-crown-b-004 'Gnarled Cupule' (bark class, band b). atom.deathblast is shipped (naming.v1.json g.on-death existingFamilies).
